name: claude-vscode-bridge
description: Exposes VSCode editor, file, run/debug, and UI actions over a local WebSocket for the Claude VSCode Bridge MCP server.

claudeBridge.port.description: Port the bridge WebSocket server listens on.

claudeBridge.mcpHttpPort.description: Port the bundled MCP server's HTTP endpoint listens on. The extension spawns this server on activation.

claudeBridge.autoConfigureMcp.description: On activation, automatically add a "vscode-bridge" MCP server entry to .mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json in each open workspace folder if one isn't already present, pointing at this extension's bundled MCP server.

scripts.build: tsc -p . --noEmit && npm run bundle:extension && npm run bundle:mcp-server
